author: /root/oraculo_metodo_r2
start_condition: All blind quality receipts for all judgeable pairs are immutable and hash-frozen.
unit: Each material direction emitted by the sole treatment bateia_recommend call.

classifications.CONFIRMED_BY_WEB: A later native web action supplies resolvable support and the output uses the finding.
classifications.REJECTED_BY_WEB: A later native web action supplies counterevidence or material misfit and the output uses the rejection.
classifications.NARROWED_BY_WEB: A later native web action converts the direction into a materially more precise hypothesis/query and the output uses it.
classifications.USED_WITHOUT_WEB_SUPPORT: The output uses the direction without adequate later public-web support.
classifications.NOT_USED: No later research or output use is observable.
classifications.UNKNOWN: Direction, later web action and output claim cannot be linked without inference.

observable_path: Bateia direction identifier/content -> strictly later duplicate-aware web lifecycle/query -> resolvable locator -> supported output claim or useful rejection.
inconclusive_rule: Bateia INCONCLUSIVE is neutral and can still seed a useful confirmed, rejected or narrowed path; status alone never determines winner.
reported_per_pair: time, calls, raw payload sizes and exposed tokens
explicit Unknown causal links or costs
attribution_rule: No catalysis claim without at least one complete observable path.
winner_policy: Treatment uplift requires blind advantage plus observable useful catalysis; otherwise report outputs and mechanism separately without forcing a winner.
